openQuestions: Official name in English and Ukrainian, canonical domain and postal address, from the official site and the EDEBO register.
Dated official statement for the current academic year on whether, where and how foreign students are taught.
State registration (EDEBO), programme licence (Ministry or EDEBO licence register) and NAQA accreditation for each health programme: three separate claims.
Which medicine, dentistry, pharmacy or nursing programmes admit foreign applicants, in which language, with what duration and intake, and the official fee page.
Location lead as found (unverified): Cherkasy (address lead: вул. Хрещатик, 215 / Khreshchatyk Street 215, consistent across the EDEBO registry, education.ua and osvita.ua search results)

Relocation lead (unverified): No relocation lead. The Cherkasy address (Khreshchatyk St 215) is consistent across the EDEBO registry, education.ua and osvita.ua results, and the academy has 2025 and 2026 admissions-campaign offers on vstup.osvita.ua plus an EDEBO admissions-portal offer (vstup.edbo.gov.ua/offer/1579659). Cherkasy is not in an occupied or front-line region. No official page was opened, so current operation is inferred from third-party admissions listings only.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Inventory group G (nursing/allied-health level) is contradicted by the 2025 and 2026 admissions listings, which show a 6-year Master's «Лікар» in 222 Medicine at a communal academy; the licence volume text in the lead is truncated and no NAQA accreditation decision for 222 Medicine (or any programme) was found — licence and accreditation remain unverified.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: No lead of any kind for admission of foreign applicants, English-medium teaching, an international office, or a Study in Ukraine portal entry; every offer found is a domestic (budget/contract, UAH-priced) offer.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Ownership wording is inconsistent across leads: EDEBO registry and education.ua indicate a regional-council (communal) body («Підпорядкування: Обласна рада»), while osvita.ua text calls it «державний заклад вищої освіти»; the full legal name with «Комунальний заклад вищої освіти … Черкаської обласної ради» was not confirmed by search.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Name confusion: an osvita.ua listing describes the apparent predecessor «Черкаський медичний коледж» (I-II accreditation level); the reorganisation into an academy, and whether a separate 'фаховий коледж' still exists under a similar name, are unconfirmed.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: English-language searches for 'Cherkasy Medical Academy' return Bohdan Khmelnytsky National University of Cherkasy (already listed) and Cherkasy State Technological University instead — easy to conflate in directories and in SEO copy.
Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Rector name (Inna Gubenko) comes from directory/registry summaries only and may be outdated.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: The contract fee leads (38,947 UAH/yr Medicine; 38,856 UAH/yr non-budget nursing) are domestic figures from a third-party aggregator; they must not be presented as fees for international applicants.

Missing evidence: No page on medacademy.ck.ua was opened (network policy): full legal name, charter/founder, rector, admissions rules, programme list and contact details are all unverified against the official site.

Missing evidence: MON licence register entry (licence number, licensed volumes, date) for 222 Medicine Master's, 223 Nursing, 226 Pharmacy and 227 Therapy and rehabilitation — the MON oblast list and 2019 PDF were returned but not read; the vstup.osvita.ua licence-volume text was truncated.
Missing evidence: NAQA accreditation decisions/certificates for any educational programme — none found; only staff expert-register PDFs.
Missing evidence: Any provision for foreign applicants (admission rules for foreigners, invitation issuance, Study in Ukraine portal listing, international office page) — not found.
Missing evidence: English-medium teaching — not found.
Missing evidence: Dentistry — no lead at all (not found).
Missing evidence: Level of the pharmacy programme (bachelor vs. master) and the speciality codes for pharmacy and therapy/rehabilitation — not shown.
Missing evidence: Date and legal act of the reorganisation of «Черкаський медичний коледж» into the academy, and whether any 'фаховий коледж' with a similar name still exists.
Missing evidence: Fees for international applicants — not found (only domestic UAH contract fees from a third-party aggregator).
Missing evidence: Current rector and governance (EDEBO summary names Inna Gubenko; may be outdated).
Missing evidence: Direct official confirmation of 2026/27 operation (only third-party campaign listings and a 2024 EDEBO offer found).

Skeptic's note: Licence and accreditation unverified: the vstup.osvita.ua licence-volume text for the 6-year Master's «Лікар» (222 Medicine) is truncated, and no NAQA accreditation decision for any programme was found (only expert-register PDFs naming its staff). Open question, not a bar.

Skeptic's note: Ownership wording inconsistent: EDEBO registry summary and education.ua indicate a regional-council (communal) body, osvita.ua calls it 'державний заклад вищої освіти'; the full legal form was not confirmed.

Skeptic's note: Apparent predecessor «Черкаський медичний коледж» (I-II accreditation level) appears in an older osvita.ua listing; the reorganisation into an academy and whether a similarly named фаховий коледж still exists are unconfirmed.
